CCP4i2ReportGeneric.p: MrBUMP is a pipeline to trial many search models in molecular replacement. It will find and prepare possible search models based on a sequence alignment between your target sequence and that of known structures in the PDB (using Phmmer by default). It then goes on to run molecular replacement (MR) on the best of these. Post MR it refine each resulting solution and do some initial model building to assess the likely success or otherwise of the molecular replacement search.
These are the search models that have been found and prepared for use in Molecular Replacement.
